name: vsuee-skill
description: High-speed CLI toolkit and AI agent skill for the Visayas State University E-Learning Environment (VSUEE Moodle).
author: Vj Mabansag

scripts.test:unit: node --test test/moodle-client.test.mjs test/moodle-client-downloads.test.mjs test/session-auth.test.mjs test/sync-manager.test.mjs test/browser-runner.test.mjs
scripts.build:release:package: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const dst='.output/build/release/package'; for (const f of ['package.json','LICENSE','plugin.json','AGENTS.md','README.md','bin','lib','skills']) fs.cpSync(f, dst + '/' + f, { recursive: true });"
scripts.clean:all:release: npm run clean:local:release ; npm run clean:global:release
scripts.workflow:stage-release: npm run output:cleanup ; npm run output:setup ; npm run build:release:package ; npm run test:pre-npm-deployment
scripts.workflow:local-deploy: npm run workflow:stage-release ; npm run clean:local:release && npm run deploy:local:release
scripts.workflow:global-deploy: npm run workflow:stage-release ; npm run clean:global:release && npm run deploy:global:release
scripts.workflow:npm-deploy: (npm run deploy:npm:release) || (npm login && npm whoami && npm run deploy:npm:release)
